name: Vivian Lagrave and the Darkstone Tablet
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Vivian Lagrave sent me word from Kargath, in the Badlands.  Through her studies, she believes there is an ancient text within Blackrock Spire that would benefit our research.  To confirm this, she will need someone to extract the text from the spire.  No easy task.

If interested, then speak with Vivian in Kargath.
narrative.offerRewardText:
It is true. I believe there is a tablet held within Blackrock Spire, a tablet that contains old alchemical recipes. I am glad you are here, for I need help in retrieving the tablet.

Make yourself comfortable, and I will explain further.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 60, 8,950 XP in all.
